from.place: Proof, passage from a finite affine etale covering family to its disjoint union and its Cech complex

title: Cech complex of a finite affine etale covering and its disjoint union
statement: Let $X=\operatorname{Spec}A$ be an affine scheme [def-weil-affine-spectrum], let $(u_i:U_i\to X)_{i\in I}$ be a finite jointly surjective family of etale morphisms [def-weil-etale-morphism], [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] with every $U_i$ affine, and let $F$ be an abelian sheaf on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Set $V=\coprod_{i\in I}U_i$ and $u:V\to X$. Then $V$ is affine, $u$ is surjective, etale, and the corresponding ring map $A\to\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$ is faithfully flat [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map]. For every $p\ge0$ the sheaf property identifies $F(V\times_X\cdots\times_XV)$ (with $p+1$ factors) with $\prod_{(i_0,\ldots,i_p)\in I^{p+1}}F(U_{i_0}\times_X\cdots\times_XU_{i_p})$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. These isomorphisms commute with all face restrictions and therefore identify the Cech complexes [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex] of the one-map cover $\{V\to X\}$ and the family $(u_i)$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 03OZ (label lemma-cech-complex), for a standard etale covering; proof including equation label equation-sheaf-coprod

proof.text: Construct u as Sigma.desc of the U_i structure maps and V as Scheme.Etale.mk u. Etaleness follows from IsZariskiLocalAtSource.sigmaDesc [lem-sc-etale-coproduct-etale]; finite coproduct affineness follows from the Mathlib instance [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-permanence]. The covering criterion [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] gives the union of the images of the f_i; the over-category equations identify these with the structure maps, and Surjective.sigmaDesc_of_union_range_eq_univ proves u surjective. Since X is Spec A and hence affine, Mathlib Flat.flat_and_surjective_iff_faithfullyFlat_of_isAffine proves faithful flatness on global sections, using flatness of etale maps [def-weil-etale-morphism], [lem-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map-iff-flat-affine], [lem-weil-pbc-flat-surjective-spectrum-faithfully-flat].

Surjectivity makes the singleton family a small-etale covering by the same covering criterion. Apply SiteCechComplex.exists_of_covering to both families. Lift the scheme coprojections to maps c_i:U_i→V in X.Etale, and use the universal property of S_2 to construct g(p,t) with projections S_1.pr(p,t,k) followed by c_(t(k)). All their composites to X agree by the defining over equations. The universal property is proved and characterizes these chosen maps uniquely; no data is chosen from an unproved mere existence result.

For each p, form the actual additive restriction map m_p(s)(t)=F(g(p,t))(s(0)); its zero and addition laws are the functor maps laws. The scheme coprojections form the coproduct cocone, so apply [lem-sc-etale-coproduct-cech-restriction-bijective] to show m_p bijective. AddEquiv.ofBijective turns these maps into degreewise isomorphisms, retaining the exact displayed forward maps.

For each omitted factor j, prove S_1.indexMap(t,j.succAbove) followed by g(p,t∘j.succAbove) equals g(p+1,t) followed by S_2.indexMap(0,j.succAbove). Both composites have the same projections by indexMap_pr and the defining projection equations for g, so the universal property gives equality. Apply F contravariantly to this equality. Distribute its additive maps through the finite signed sum defining the differential; each term agrees, proving m_p d_1=d_2 m_(p+1). HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents assembles the degreewise isomorphisms into the required complex isomorphism.

lean.statement: theorem etale_standard_cover_cech (A : CommRingCat.{u}) (X : Scheme.{u}) (hX : X = AlgebraicGeometry.Spec A) (I : Type u) [Finite I] (U : I → X.Etale) (hU : ∀ i : I, IsAffine (U i).left) (f : ∀ i : I, U i ⟶ Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)) (hcover : Sieve.ofArrows U f ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology _) (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) : ∃ (V : X.Etale) (fV : V ⟶ Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)), V.left = (∐ fun i : I => (U i).left) ∧ IsAffine V.left ∧ Surjective V.hom ∧ Etale V.hom ∧ RingHom.FaithfullyFlat ((Scheme.Γ.map V.hom.op).hom) ∧ ∃ (S₁ : CategoryTheory.SiteCechComplex U f) (S₂ : CategoryTheory.SiteCechComplex (fun _ : Fin 1 => V) (fun _ : Fin 1 => fV)), Nonempty (S₂.complex F.obj ≅ S₁.complex F.obj)
